status_rule: Documented describes a first-party product/docs concept; it is not authenticated/live or implemented evidence.

atoms.label: Intake and normalize
atoms.outcome: Turn an inbound request, message, file, or event into a typed work item with required fields.
atoms.trigger: New email, form, file, event, or human request.
atoms.state: Raw payload plus tenant, requester, received_at, source link, and missing-field list.
atoms.decision: Complete, duplicate, safe, and owned, or request missing data/escalate.
atoms.side_effect: Create/update a work item or request missing information.
atoms.authority: Owner approves consequential messages and system-of-record writes.
atoms.verification: Required fields, tenant/identity, source link, and duplicate-key checks.
atoms.recovery: Preserve original, mark incomplete/duplicate, retry idempotently, route exceptions.
atoms.audit: Source event, normalized payload, classifier/version, actor, timestamps, and approval receipt.

atoms.label: Triage and route
atoms.outcome: Assign category, urgency, owner, queue, and service target.
atoms.trigger: New normalized item or state/priority change.
atoms.state: Classification, confidence, owner/queue, SLA target, and escalation state.
atoms.decision: Route, escalate, or human-review based on evidence and confidence.
atoms.side_effect: Create assignment, task, ticket, or alert.
atoms.authority: Agent routes only within an allow-list; sensitive commitments require approval.
atoms.verification: Confidence threshold, valid owner, SLA timestamp, and no duplicate assignment.
atoms.recovery: Return to unassigned queue and preserve prior route.
atoms.audit: Input snapshot, rationale, confidence, target, and human override.

atoms.label: Extract and structure
atoms.outcome: Convert documents, transcripts, emails, or pages into validated fields and linked entities.
atoms.state: Raw artifact plus fields, confidence, provenance spans, and unresolved values.
atoms.decision: Continue at confidence threshold or send to human review.
atoms.side_effect: Stage structured data for a work item, ledger, CRM, task, or report.
atoms.authority: Data owner approves consequential record writes.
atoms.verification: Schema, totals/date checks, source spans, duplicate detection, and confidence threshold.
atoms.recovery: Retry with artifact key; quarantine bad parses with original source.
atoms.audit: Artifact hash, extractor/model version, field confidence, locator, reviewer, final values.

atoms.label: Classify and prioritize
atoms.outcome: Apply domain labels, priority, risk, and next-best action.
atoms.state: Labels, priority, confidence, policy flags, and suggested action.
atoms.decision: Allow-listed action, approval, or exception handling.
atoms.side_effect: Update queue metadata, create review task, or prepare draft.
atoms.authority: Advisory until policy owner approves sensitive decisions.
atoms.verification: Rule trace, confidence, policy check, and override path.
atoms.recovery: Reclassify from preserved input and block downstream side effects.
atoms.audit: Feature snapshot, rule/model version, classification, confidence, override history.

atoms.label: Follow up and chase
atoms.outcome: Move a stalled or time-sensitive item forward with an approved reminder or response.
atoms.trigger: New lead/request, missing document, aging invoice, renewal, or SLA threshold.
atoms.state: Last contact, next due time, consent/policy, and escalation count.
atoms.decision: Draft, send within policy, escalate, or stop as resolved/opted out.
atoms.side_effect: Draft/send message, create task, schedule follow-up, or notify owner.
atoms.authority: Approval before first contact, financial demand, legal commitment, or non-allow-listed send.
atoms.verification: Recipient, template variables, consent/opt-out, source update, and send receipt.
atoms.recovery: Cancel queued send, mark delivery failure, preserve thread, retry by key.
atoms.audit: Trigger, draft, approval, recipient, receipt, response, and next due time.

atoms.label: Schedule and coordinate
atoms.outcome: Find an acceptable slot/service window and align participants, tasks, and reminders.
atoms.trigger: Meeting/service request, missed appointment, candidate stage, or recurrence.
atoms.state: Candidate slots, timezone, constraints, confirmation, and cancellation/no-show state.
atoms.decision: Choose compliant slot and determine approval need.
atoms.side_effect: Create/update calendar event, send confirmation/reminder, or task.
atoms.authority: Owner approves sensitive bookings and cancellations.
atoms.verification: Calendar read-back, participant/slot match, timezone, notification receipt.
atoms.recovery: Release hold, restore prior event, rebook from constraints, notify affected parties.
atoms.audit: Availability snapshot, chosen slot, actor, approval, event ID, notifications.

atoms.label: Reconcile and audit
atoms.outcome: Compare records, explain matches/mismatches, and produce a reviewable exception queue.
atoms.trigger: New statement/payment/receipt, scheduled close, or record change.
atoms.state: Matched pairs, unmatched items, tolerance/policy result, and reviewer status.
atoms.decision: Safe to post/close or human exception.
atoms.side_effect: Stage ledger/CRM update, create exception, or draft query.
atoms.authority: Finance/data owner approves posting, write-off, payment, or dispute.
atoms.verification: Totals, dates, currency, duplicate key, tolerance, source links, post-write read-back.
atoms.recovery: Preserve snapshots, reverse staged writes, reopen exception, never discard unmatched data.
atoms.audit: Input hashes, match rule/tolerance, before/after, approver, resolution.

atoms.label: Report and digest
atoms.outcome: Turn current work and metrics into a source-linked decision-ready report.
atoms.trigger: Schedule, completed batch, threshold, meeting, or request.
atoms.state: Period, metric values, freshness, anomalies, unresolved items.
atoms.side_effect: Create dashboard/report, draft recap, or post to approved channel.
atoms.authority: Owner approves client-facing or sensitive numbers.
atoms.verification: Recomputed totals, source links, freshness, recipient/channel, delivery receipt.
atoms.recovery: Mark partial, supersede draft, rerun from frozen period, preserve prior version.
atoms.audit: Query/version, period, source snapshots, report, approver, publication, revisions.

atoms.label: Monitor and alert
atoms.outcome: Watch a system, queue, metric, or web surface and notify the right owner on meaningful change.
atoms.trigger: Schedule, event, threshold, webhook/data change, or AI condition.
atoms.state: Observed value, baseline, threshold, last alert, acknowledgement, escalation.
atoms.decision: New action, duplicate, recovery, or noise.
atoms.side_effect: Create alert/task, post notification, or open incident/review.
atoms.authority: Agent alerts; remediation needs explicit allow-list and approval.
atoms.verification: Source read-back, deduplication key, threshold, recipient, acknowledgement.
atoms.recovery: Suppress duplicates, mark false positives, recover source outage, escalate unacknowledged.
atoms.audit: Poll/event, calculation, payload, delivery, acknowledgement, resolution.

atoms.label: Approve and publish
atoms.outcome: Move a prepared artifact/action through explicit approval into a controlled side effect.
atoms.trigger: Draft/diff ready, review queue, threshold, or approval request.
atoms.state: Draft, diff, policy checks, approver, expiry, publication state.
atoms.decision: Approve, revise, reject, defer, or escalate.
atoms.side_effect: Send, post, publish, commit, file, update record, or trigger job.
atoms.authority: Named approver owns consequential action; silence is not approval.
atoms.verification: Approval identity, exact payload/diff, policy checks, post-action read-back, receipt.
atoms.recovery: Cancel, compensate/reverse, supersede output, record residual risk.
atoms.audit: Draft versions, decisions, identity, receipt, verification, recovery.

atoms.label: Sync and hand off
atoms.outcome: Carry a validated state transition between systems or owners without losing context.
atoms.trigger: Status change, completed sale/request, new record, or scheduled reconciliation.
atoms.state: Source/target state, mapping/version, delivery, owner acknowledgement.
atoms.side_effect: Create/update task, ticket, CRM record, project item, or notification.
atoms.authority: Allow-listed fields only; ownership and customer commitments require approval.
atoms.verification: Target read-back, source/target IDs, mapping, no duplicate, acknowledgement.
atoms.recovery: Retry by key, compensate target, restore prior owner/status, surface conflicts.
atoms.audit: IDs, mapping, payload diff, actor, write receipt, acknowledgement.

atoms.label: Operate browser-only software
atoms.outcome: Read/update an API-less app through a controlled, observable browser operation.
atoms.trigger: Approved work item, schedule, threshold, or human request.
atoms.state: Browser/session, target record, intended changes, permissions, checkpoint.
atoms.decision: Expected target and authorized action, or pause for inspection.
atoms.side_effect: Allow-listed UI action, upload/file, status change, or message.
atoms.authority: Named owner grants app/session scope; sensitive actions pause for confirmation.
atoms.verification: UI read-back, screenshot/DOM evidence where available, receipt, audit event.
atoms.recovery: Stop/rollback if possible, mark uncertain, route to human inspection.
atoms.audit: Session/app, action trace, page/record IDs, approval, evidence, result.
